objects.name: zcds_simple_demo1
objects.description: Demonstration CDS view over sales document headers (VBAK) exposing document number, category, sales organisation, distribution channel, division and sold-to party. It shows a nested CASE expression that translates the document category into text such as Inquiry, Quotation, or Order paid/not paid based on net value, and exposes $session variables (client, system date, language, user, timezone). Commented-out code shows how to add input parameters. Useful as a CDS syntax learning example.

objects.name: zmm_po_doc
objects.description: CDS view listing purchase order headers from EKKO restricted to standard purchase orders (document category F), exposing PO number, document category and vendor. It defines a one-to-many association to purchase order items (EKPO) named POI so consumers can navigate from header to items. Useful as a base view for purchasing reports or OData services that need PO header data with drill-down to line items.

objects.name: zsd_date_func
objects.description: Demonstration CDS view over sales orders (VBAK, category C with non-zero net value) showcasing CDS date functions. It uses DATS_IS_VALID to check a date format, DATS_DAYS_BETWEEN to compute days between order and delivery dates, DATS_ADD_DAYS to derive an expected delivery date, and DATS_ADD_MONTHS to add a month, mostly on hard-coded literal dates. Use it as a syntax reference for date arithmetic in CDS.

objects.name: zsd_ds_func
objects.description: Demonstration CDS view over INR sales orders from VBAK showing how DECIMAL_SHIFT behaves. It outputs the original net value alongside six variants shifted according to pseudo-currency codes 0 through 5, illustrating how amounts are adjusted for currencies with different numbers of decimal places. Use it as a syntax reference when currency amount conversion or decimal handling is needed in CDS views.

objects.name: zsd_dt_conv
objects.description: Demonstration CDS view over sales orders (VBAK) illustrating timestamp and time zone functions. It returns the current UTC timestamp, splits it into date and time with TSTMP_TO_DATS and TSTMP_TO_TIMS using the system time zone via ABAP_SYSTEM_TIMEZONE, derives the daylight saving indicator with TSTMP_TO_DST, and rebuilds a timestamp from order creation date and time using DATS_TIMS_TO_TSTMP. Use it as a syntax reference for timestamp conversion in CDS.

objects.description: An empty proxy implementation class for inbound flight booking messages via SAP XI/PI or the Application Interface Framework. It contains no methods, attributes or logic yet, so it currently does nothing. A developer would use it as the placeholder where inbound flight booking request processing is meant to be implemented, alongside the ZAIF_II_FLIGHTBOOKING_IN interface and the SXIDAL_FBO_REQUEST_MT message type from SAP's flight demo scenario.

*                        beneaccnum = is_beneficiary-beneaccnum
*                        beneifsccode = is_beneficiary-beneifsccode
*                        beneactype = is_beneficiary-beneactype
*                        benebankname = is_beneficiary-benebankname
*                        beneaddr1 = is_beneficiary-beneaddr1
*                        beneemail = is_beneficiary-beneemail
*                        benemobile = is_beneficiary-benemobile
*                        benelei = is_beneficiary-benelei
*                  ) )
*                )
*              )
*            ).
*
*        " Calculate checksum
*        ls_request-beneficiaryregistrationrequest-benfregreqbody-checksum =
*          calculate_checksum( ls_request ).
****************************END FOR NOW
***************************        rEQUEST bODY
        DATA(ls_request) = VALUE ty_main_request(
              beneficiaryregistrationrequest = VALUE #(
                subheader = VALUE #(
                  requestuuid = lv_uuid
                  servicerequestid = 'OpenAPI'
                  servicerequestversion = '1.0'
                  channelid = c_channel_id
                )
                benfregreqbody = VALUE #(
                  channelid = c_channel_id
                  corpcode = 'DEMOCORP11'
                  userid = sy-uname
                  beneinsert = it_beneficiary
                )
              )
            ).

        ls_request-beneficiaryregistrationrequest-benfregreqbody-checksum =
                  calculate_checksum( ls_request ).

        " 3. Convert complete request to JSON xstring
*        DATA(lv_request_xstring) = serialize_to_json_xstring( ls_request ).
*******************************************************


*********************************************************************************
        DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sxml_string_writer=>create(
                type = if_sxml=>co_xt_json
                ignore_conversion_errors = abap_false
            ).

        " Transform data to JSON
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
            SOURCE data = ls_request
            RESULT XML lo_writer.

        "3 Get the JSON as xstring
        DATA(lv_xjson) = lo_writer->get_output( ).

        " 4. Encrypt the entire request
        DATA(lv_encrypted_data) = encrypt_request_body( lv_xjson ).

***         5. Prepare final request with encrypted data
*        DATA(ls_final_request) = VALUE ty_encrypted_request(
*          beneficiaryregistrationrequest = VALUE #(
*            subheader = ls_request-beneficiaryregistrationrequest-subheader
*            beneficiaryregistrationrequestbodyencrypted = lv_encrypted_data
*          )
*        ).

        DATA(ls_final_request) = VALUE ty_encrypted_request(
            beneficiaryregistrationrequest-benfregreqbodyencrypted = lv_encrypted_data
).

        " Convert xstring to string
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
            input = lv_xjson
            encoding = 'UTF-8'
        ).

        DATA: lv_json TYPE xstring.
*        lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = lv_json ).
        lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = ls_final_request ).

        " Alternative if SXML gives empty result
        IF lv_json IS INITIAL.
          CLEAR lv_json.
          /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
              EXPORTING
                  data             = ls_request
                  compress         = abap_false
                  pretty_name      = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-low_case
                  assoc_arrays     = abap_true
              RECEIVING
                  r_json          = lv_json
          ).
        ENDIF.

        " Verify JSON output is not empty
        IF lv_json IS INITIAL.
*          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

*************************************************
        " Create HTTP client

        DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
        CALL METHOD cl_http_client=>create_by_url
          EXPORTING
            url    = 'https://sakshamuat.axisbank.co.in/gateway/api/txb/v1/payee-mgmt/beneficiary-registration'
            ssl_id = 'ANONYM'
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client.

        " Set request method
        lo_http_client->request->set_method('POST').

        " Set headers
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
          name  = 'Content-Type'
          value = 'application/json; charset=utf-8' "'application/json'
        ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
                 name  = 'X-IBM-Client-Id'
                 value = mv_client_id
               ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
              name  = 'X-IBM-Client-Secret'
              value = mv_client_secret
            ).

        " Convert xstring to binary and set as body
        DATA: lv_length TYPE i.
        DATA: lv_binary TYPE xstring.
        DATA: lt_binary TYPE TABLE OF x255.

        CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_XSTRING_TO_BINARY'
          EXPORTING
            buffer        = lv_xjson
          IMPORTING
            output_length = lv_length
          TABLES
            binary_tab    = lt_binary.

        CONCATENATE LINES OF lt_binary INTO lv_binary IN BYTE MODE.

        " Set binary content
        lo_http_client->request->set_data( lv_binary ).
*        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json ).

        " Send request
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state        = 2
            http_processing_failed    = 3
            http_invalid_timeout      = 4
            OTHERS                    = 5
        ).

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
*      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.


        " Receive response
        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state        = 2
            http_processing_failed    = 3
            OTHERS                    = 4
        ).

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
*          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        " Get response
        DATA: lt_response_binary TYPE TABLE OF x255.
        DATA: lv_response_xstring TYPE xstring.

        " Get binary response
        DATA : lv_response TYPE xstring.
        " Get response
        lv_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

        " Convert binary to xstring
        CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_BINARY_TO_XSTRING'
          EXPORTING
            input_length = xstrlen( lv_response )
          IMPORTING
            buffer       = lv_response_xstring
          TABLES
            binary_tab   = lt_response_binary.

        DATA: BEGIN OF ls_response,
                status  TYPE string,
                message TYPE string,
              END OF ls_response.


        " Convert xstring response to string for JSON parsing
        lo_conv = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          input = lv_response_xstring
          encoding = 'UTF-8'
        ).

*        DATA(lv_response_string) = lo_conv->read( ).
*
*        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
*          EXPORTING
*            json = lv_response_string
*          CHANGING
*            data = ls_response
*        ).

        " Set success based on response status
*        rv_success = xsdbool( ls_response-status = 'S' ).


*        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
*               EXPORTING
*                 json = lv_response
*               CHANGING
*                 data = ls_response
*             ).

        " Set success based on response status
*        rv_success = xsdbool( ls_response-status = 'S' ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
*        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
*          EXPORTING
*            previous = lx_root.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.


  method SERIALIZE_REQUEST.
  endmethod.


  method VALIDATE_BENEFICIARY.
  endmethod.


  METHOD xstring_to_string.

    DATA: lv_xlen TYPE i,
          lv_hex  TYPE c LENGTH 2.

    lv_xlen = xstrlen( iv_xstring ).

    DO lv_xlen TIMES.
      GET BIT sy-index OF iv_xstring INTO lv_hex.
      rv_string = |{ rv_string }{ lv_hex }|.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
objects.description: Integration class that registers vendor bank beneficiaries with Axis Bank's TXB payee-management REST API. It defines the JSON request structures (subheader, beneficiary insert list, encrypted body), stores client ID and secret, calculates an MD5 checksum, AES-encrypts the request body, serialises it via /UI2/CL_JSON, posts to the bank's UAT beneficiary-registration endpoint and parses the response status. Several helper methods (validation, serialisation) are still stubs. Use it when a payment run needs vendors registered as payees before bank transfers.

objects.name: zcl_zca_applog
objects.source:
class ZCL_ZCA_APPLOG definition
  public
  final
  create public .

public section.

  methods CONSTRUCTOR
    importing
      !IV_OBJECT type BALOBJ_D optional
      !IV_SUBOBJECT type BALSUBOBJ optional
      !IV_EXTNUMBER type ANY optional
      !IV_TITLE type BALTITLE optional
      !IV_FROM_DB type ABAP_BOOL optional
      !IV_LOG_HANDLE type BALLOGHNDL optional .
  methods ADD_HEADER
    importing
      !IV_EXTNUMBER type ANY optional .
  methods ADD_EX_MESSAGE
    importing
      !IO_EX type ref to CX_ROOT .
  methods ADD_MESSAGE
    importing
      !IV_MSGID type SYMSGID optional
      !IV_MSGTY type SYMSGTY optional
      !IV_MSGNO type SYMSGNO optional
      !IV_MSGV1 type ANY optional
      !IV_MSGV2 type ANY optional
      !IV_MSGV3 type ANY optional
      !IS_BAPIRET2 type BAPIRET2 optional
      !IS_CONTEXT type BAL_S_CONT optional
      !IV_MSGV4 type ANY optional .
  methods ADD_MESSAGES
    importing
      !IT_BAPIRET2 type BAPIRET2_T optional .
  methods ADD_SY_MESSAGE
    importing
      !IS_CONTEXT type BAL_S_CONT optional .
  methods DISPLAY
    importing
      !IV_SHOW_TREE type ABAP_BOOL optional
      !IV_STANDARD_DISP type ABAP_BOOL optional .
  class-methods WRITE_OUTPUT
    importing
      !IT_LOG_HANDLE type BAL_T_LOGH optional
      !IV_SHOW_SEPARATOR type ABAP_BOOL default ABAP_TRUE .
  class-methods GET_MESSAGE_TYPE_ICON
    importing
      !IV_MSGTY type SYMSGTY
    returning
      value(RV_ICON) type ICON_D .
  methods MESSAGE_EXIST
    returning
      value(RV_EXIST) type ABAP_BOOL .
  class-methods DISPLAY_LOG
    importing
      !IV_OBJECT type BALOBJ_D default TEXT-003
      !IV_SUBOBJECT type BALSUBOBJ optional
      !IV_TITLE type BALTITLE optional
      !IV_SHOW_TREE type ABAP_BOOL optional
      !IV_STANDARD_DISP type ABAP_BOOL optional
      !IV_EXTNUMBER type ANY optional
      !IT_MSG type BAPIRET2_T optional .
  methods SAVE .
protected section.
private section.

  data MV_LOG_HANDLE type BALLOGHNDL .
  data MS_LOG_HDR type BAL_S_LOG .
  data MV_TITLE type BALTITLE .
  data MV_NMESSAGES type I .
  data MV_OBJECT type BALOBJ_D .
  data MV_SUBOBJECT type BALSUBOBJ .
  data MT_LOG_HANDLE type BAL_T_LOGH .
  data GV_DUMMY type STRING .
  constants:
    BEGIN OF gc_icon,
      success TYPE icon_d VALUE '@5B@',
      warning TYPE icon_d VALUE '@5D@',
      error   TYPE icon_d VALUE '@5C@',
      other   TYPE icon_d VALUE '@5F@',
    END OF gc_icon .
  constants GC_STACK_LEVEL type I value '2' ##NO_TEXT.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS ZCL_ZCA_APPLOG IMPLEMENTATION.


  method ADD_EX_MESSAGE.
        CONSTANTS:
      lc_detlevel_9 TYPE c VALUE '9'.
    DATA:
      ls_exc TYPE bal_s_exc,
      lo_ex  TYPE REF TO zcx_zca_exception.

    ls_exc-msgty = cl_esh_adm_constants=>gc_msgty_e.
    ls_exc-exception = io_ex.
    ls_exc-detlevel = lc_detlevel_9.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_LOG_EXCEPTION_ADD'
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle     = me->mv_log_handle
        i_s_exc          = ls_exc
      EXCEPTIONS
        log_not_found    = 1
        msg_inconsistent = 2
        log_is_full      = 3
        OTHERS           = 4.


    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_ex.
      lo_ex->append_message_sy( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION lo_ex.
    ELSE.
      ADD 1 TO mv_nmessages.
    ENDIF.

  endmethod.


  method ADD_HEADER.

    DATA:
      lt_callstack TYPE sys_callst,
      lo_ex        TYPE REF TO zcx_zca_exception.

    CALL FUNCTION 'SYSTEM_CALLSTACK'
      IMPORTING
        et_callstack = lt_callstack.

    DESCRIBE TABLE lt_callstack.
    IF sy-tfill EQ 0.
      ms_log_hdr-alprog = sy-repid.
    ELSE.
      READ TABLE lt_callstack INDEX sy-tfill ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_callstack>).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        ms_log_hdr-alprog = sy-repid.
      ELSE.
        ms_log_hdr-alprog = <lfs_callstack>-progname.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    ms_log_hdr-extnumber = iv_extnumber.
    ms_log_hdr-object = mv_object.
    ms_log_hdr-subobject = mv_subobject.
    ms_log_hdr-aldate = sy-datum.
    ms_log_hdr-altime = sy-uzeit.
    ms_log_hdr-aluser = sy-uname.
    ms_log_hdr-altcode = sy-tcode.
    ms_log_hdr-almode = sy-batch.
    ms_log_hdr-alchdate = sy-datum.
    ms_log_hdr-alchtime = sy-uzeit.
    ms_log_hdr-alchuser = sy-uname.
    ms_log_hdr-aldate_del = sy-datum.
    ADD 183 TO ms_log_hdr-aldate_del.
    ms_log_hdr-del_before = abap_true.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_LOG_CREATE'
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log                 = ms_log_hdr
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle            = mv_log_handle
      EXCEPTIONS
        log_header_inconsistent = 1.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_ex.
      lo_ex->append_message_sy( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION lo_ex.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT mv_log_handle INTO TABLE mt_log_handle.

  endmethod.


  method ADD_MESSAGE.

        DATA:
      ls_msg TYPE bal_s_msg,
      lo_ex  TYPE REF TO zcx_zca_exception.

    IF ( iv_msgty IS INITIAL OR iv_msgid IS INITIAL )
      AND  is_bapiret2 IS INITIAL.

      CREATE OBJECT lo_ex.
      MESSAGE e491(00) INTO gv_dummy.
      lo_ex->append_message_sy( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION lo_ex.

    ENDIF.

    IF is_bapiret2 IS NOT INITIAL.
      ls_msg-msgty  = is_bapiret2-type.
      ls_msg-msgid  = is_bapiret2-id.
      ls_msg-msgno  = is_bapiret2-number.
      ls_msg-msgv1  = is_bapiret2-message_v1.
      ls_msg-msgv2  = is_bapiret2-message_v2.
      ls_msg-msgv3  = is_bapiret2-message_v3.
      ls_msg-msgv4  = is_bapiret2-message_v4.
    ELSE.
      ls_msg-msgid  = iv_msgid.
      ls_msg-msgty  = iv_msgty.
      ls_msg-msgno  = iv_msgno.
      ls_msg-msgv1  = iv_msgv1.
      ls_msg-msgv2  = iv_msgv2.
      ls_msg-msgv3  = iv_msgv3.
      ls_msg-msgv4  = Iv_msgv4.
    ENDIF.

    IF is_context IS NOT INITIAL.
      ls_msg-context = is_context.
    ENDIF.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_LOG_MSG_ADD'
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle     = mv_log_handle
        i_s_msg          = ls_msg
      EXCEPTIONS
        log_not_found    = 1
        msg_inconsistent = 2
        log_is_full      = 3
        OTHERS           = 4.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_ex.
      lo_ex->append_message_sy( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION lo_ex.
    ELSE.
      ADD 1 TO mv_nmessages.
    ENDIF.

  endmethod.


  method ADD_MESSAGES.

    LOOP AT it_bapiret2 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_msg>).
      me->add_message( is_bapiret2 = <lfs_msg> ).
    ENDLOOP.

  endmethod.


  method ADD_SY_MESSAGE.
        me->add_message( iv_msgid = sy-msgid
                     iv_msgno = sy-msgno
                     iv_msgty = sy-msgty
                     iv_msgv1 = sy-msgv1
                     iv_msgv2 = sy-msgv2
                     iv_msgv3 = sy-msgv3
                     iv_msgv4 = sy-msgv4
                     is_context = is_context ).

  endmethod.


  method CONSTRUCTOR.

    DATA:
          lo_ex TYPE REF TO zcx_zca_exception.

    mv_object = iv_object.
    mv_subobject = iv_subobject.

    IF iv_from_db EQ abap_false.

      IF iv_title IS INITIAL.
        mv_title = TEXT-000.
      ELSE.
        mv_title = iv_title.
      ENDIF.

      IF iv_extnumber IS INITIAL.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_ex.
        MESSAGE e491(00) INTO gv_dummy.
        lo_ex->append_message_sy( ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lo_ex.
      ENDIF.

      me->add_header( iv_extnumber = iv_extnumber ).
    ELSE.
      IF iv_log_handle IS NOT INITIAL.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_LOG_HDR_READ'
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle  = iv_log_handle
          IMPORTING
            e_s_log       = ms_log_hdr
          EXCEPTIONS
            log_not_found = 1
            OTHERS        = 2.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          CREATE OBJECT lo_ex.
          lo_ex->append_message_sy( ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION lo_ex.
        ELSE.
          IF iv_title IS INITIAL.
            me->mv_title = TEXT-000.
          ELSE.
            me->mv_title = iv_title.
          ENDIF.
          mv_log_handle = iv_log_handle.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.


  endmethod.


  method DISPLAY.

        DATA:
      ls_profile_single TYPE bal_s_prof,
      ls_profile        TYPE bal_s_prof,
      lo_ex             TYPE REF TO zcx_zca_exception.

    CHECK:  mv_nmessages > 0,
            mv_log_handle IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF sy-batch IS INITIAL.
      IF iv_standard_disp = abap_true.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_DSP_PROFILE_STANDARD_GET'
          IMPORTING
            e_s_display_profile = ls_profile.

        ls_profile-tree_adjst  = abap_true.
        ls_profile-show_all = abap_true.

      ELSE.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_DSP_PROFILE_POPUP_GET'
          IMPORTING
            e_s_display_profile = ls_profile_single.
        IF iv_show_tree = abap_true.
          CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_DSP_PROFILE_SINGLE_LOG_GET'
            IMPORTING
              e_s_display_profile = ls_profile_single.
          ls_profile_single-start_col = ls_profile-start_col.
          ls_profile_single-start_row = ls_profile-start_row.
          ls_profile_single-end_col   = ls_profile-end_col.
          ls_profile_single-end_row   = ls_profile-end_row.
          ls_profile = ls_profile_single.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      ls_profile-title = me->mv_title.
      ls_profile-use_grid = abap_true.

      CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_DSP_LOG_DISPLAY'
        EXPORTING
          i_s_display_profile  = ls_profile
          i_t_log_handle       = mt_log_handle
        EXCEPTIONS
          profile_inconsistent = 1
          internal_error       = 2
          no_data_available    = 3
          no_authority         = 4
          OTHERS               = 5.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_ex.
        lo_ex->append_message_sy( ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lo_ex.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      write_output( it_log_handle = mt_log_handle ).
    ENDIF.

  endmethod.


  method DISPLAY_LOG.

        CONSTANTS:
    lc_extnum_dummy TYPE char10 VALUE '__DUMM'.

    DATA:
      lr_log       TYPE REF TO zcl_zca_applog,
      lv_extnumber TYPE string,
      lo_ex        TYPE REF TO zcx_zca_exception.

    TRY.
        IF iv_extnumber IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_extnumber = iv_extnumber.
        ELSE.
          lv_extnumber = lc_extnum_dummy.
        ENDIF.

        CREATE OBJECT lr_log
          EXPORTING
            iv_object    = iv_object
            iv_subobject = iv_subobject
            iv_extnumber = iv_extnumber
            iv_title     = iv_title.

        lr_log->add_messages( it_msg ).

        lr_log->display( ).

      CATCH zcx_zca_exception INTO lo_ex.
*        lo_ex->display( ).
    ENDTRY.


  endmethod.


  method GET_MESSAGE_TYPE_ICON.

        CASE iv_msgty.
      WHEN cl_esh_adm_constants=>gc_msgty_s OR cl_esh_adm_constants=>gc_msgty_i.
        rv_icon = gc_icon-success.
      WHEN cl_esh_adm_constants=>gc_msgty_w.
        rv_icon = gc_icon-warning.
      WHEN cl_esh_adm_constants=>gc_msgty_e.
        rv_icon = gc_icon-error.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_icon = gc_icon-other.
    ENDCASE.

  endmethod.


  method MESSAGE_EXIST.
        IF mv_nmessages > 0.
      rv_exist = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.


  method SAVE.
        DATA:
          lt_log_handle TYPE bal_t_logh.

    APPEND mv_log_handle TO lt_log_handle.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_DB_SAVE'
      EXPORTING
        i_t_log_handle   = lt_log_handle
      EXCEPTIONS
        log_not_found    = 1
        save_not_allowed = 2
        numbering_error  = 3
        OTHERS           = 4.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    ELSE.
    ENDIF.

  endmethod.


  method WRITE_OUTPUT.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF lty_hdr,
        log_handle TYPE balloghndl,
        hdr        TYPE bal_s_log,
      END OF lty_hdr.

    DATA:
      lt_msg_handle    TYPE bal_t_msgh,
      lv_msg_text(300) TYPE c,
      ls_msg           TYPE bal_s_msg,
      lv_icon          TYPE icon_d,
      lv_log_handle    TYPE balloghndl,
      ls_bal_s_log     TYPE bal_s_log,
      lt_hdr           TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF lty_hdr.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_GLB_SEARCH_MSG'
      EXPORTING
        i_t_log_handle = it_log_handle
      IMPORTING
        e_t_msg_handle = lt_msg_handle
      EXCEPTIONS
        msg_not_found  = 1
        OTHERS         = 2.

    CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
    SORT lt_hdr BY log_handle.
    LOOP AT lt_msg_handle ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_msghandle>).
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_LOG_MSG_READ'
        EXPORTING
          i_s_msg_handle = <lfs_msghandle>
        IMPORTING
          e_s_msg        = ls_msg
          e_txt_msg      = lv_msg_text
        EXCEPTIONS
          log_not_found  = 1
          msg_not_found  = 2
          OTHERS         = 3.

      CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
      READ TABLE lt_hdr WITH KEY log_handle = <lfs_msghandle>-log_handle BINARY SEARCH
        ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_hdr>).

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.

        CALL FUNCTION 'BAL_LOG_HDR_READ'
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle  = <lfs_msghandle>-log_handle
          IMPORTING
            e_s_log       = ls_bal_s_log
          EXCEPTIONS
            log_not_found = 1
            OTHERS        = 2.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_hdr ASSIGNING <lfs_hdr>.
          CLEAR <lfs_hdr>.
          <lfs_hdr>-log_handle = <lfs_msghandle>-log_handle.
          <lfs_hdr>-hdr = ls_bal_s_log.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      IF iv_show_separator = abap_true AND lv_log_handle <> <lfs_msghandle>-log_handle.
        ULINE.
        WRITE:/ <lfs_hdr>-hdr-extnumber.
        lv_log_handle = <lfs_msghandle>-log_handle.

      ENDIF.

      lv_icon = get_message_type_icon( ls_msg-msgty ).
      WRITE: /1(3) lv_icon AS ICON, 5(*) lv_msg_text.
    ENDLOOP.


  endmethod.
ENDCLASS.
objects.description: Reusable wrapper around SAP Application Log (SLG0/SLG1) built on the BAL_LOG_* function modules. It creates a log header from the call stack, adds single messages, BAPIRET2 tables, system messages or exception objects, saves the log to the database, displays it as a tree or standard view, and writes messages with type icons to list output. Raises ZCX_ZCA_EXCEPTION on failures. Use it whenever a program or interface needs consistent application logging.

objects.source:
class ZCL_ZSD_SALESORDER definition
  public
  final
  create public .

public section.

  class-data GV_INSTANCE type ref to ZCL_ZSD_SALESORDER .

  methods CHECK_SF_REF_ALREADY_EXISTS
    importing
      !IV_SF_REF type CHAR20
    returning
      value(RV_VBELN_VA) type VBELN_VA .
  class-methods GET_INSTANCE
    returning
      value(RO_INSTANCE) type ref to ZCL_ZSD_SALESORDER .

  METHOD append_sy_message_to_bapiret2.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO ct_bapiret2 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_bapiret2>).
    CLEAR <lfs_bapiret2>.
    <lfs_bapiret2>-id = sy-msgid.
    <lfs_bapiret2>-type = sy-msgty.
    <lfs_bapiret2>-number = sy-msgno.
    <lfs_bapiret2>-message_v1 = sy-msgv1.
    <lfs_bapiret2>-message_v2 = sy-msgv2.
    <lfs_bapiret2>-message_v3 = sy-msgv3.
    <lfs_bapiret2>-message_v4 = sy-msgv4 .
    MESSAGE ID <lfs_bapiret2>-id
            TYPE <lfs_bapiret2>-type
            NUMBER <lfs_bapiret2>-number
            WITH <lfs_bapiret2>-message_v1 <lfs_bapiret2>-message_v2 <lfs_bapiret2>-message_v3 <lfs_bapiret2>-message_v4
            INTO <lfs_bapiret2>-message.
  ENDMETHOD.


  method BAPI_CONVERSIONS.


     DATA:
      ls_bape_vbak  TYPE bape_vbak,
      ls_bape_vbakx TYPE bape_vbakx,
      ls_bape_vbap  TYPE bape_vbap,
      ls_bape_vbapx TYPE bape_vbapx.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_bape_vbak  TYPE te_struc VALUE 'BAPE_VBAK',
      lc_bape_vbakx TYPE te_struc VALUE 'BAPE_VBAKX',
      lc_bape_vbap  TYPE te_struc VALUE 'BAPE_VBAP',
      lc_bape_vbapx TYPE te_struc VALUE 'BAPE_VBAPX',
      lc_kappl_v    TYPE kappl VALUE 'V',
      lc_krech_a    TYPE krech VALUE 'A',
      lc_krech_h    TYPE krech VALUE 'H',
      lc_krech_i    TYPE krech VALUE 'I'.


    LOOP AT mt_bapiparnr ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_bapiparnr>).
    ENDLOOP.

* Processing header extension
    CLEAR ls_bape_vbak.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_bapiparex ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_bapiparex>).
    CLEAR <lfs_bapiparex>.
*    ls_bape_vbak-zz_refno_ext   = ms_deep_entity-salesforcereference. for now didnt add any custom field in ideas
    <lfs_bapiparex>-structure    = lc_bape_vbak.
    <lfs_bapiparex>-valuepart1   = ls_bape_vbak.

    CLEAR ls_bape_vbakx.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_bapiparex ASSIGNING <lfs_bapiparex>.
    CLEAR <lfs_bapiparex>.
*    ls_bape_vbakx-zz_refno_ext  = abap_true. for now didnt add any custom field in ideas
    <lfs_bapiparex>-structure    = lc_bape_vbakx.
    <lfs_bapiparex>-valuepart1   = ls_bape_vbakx.

    ms_bapisdhd1-po_method = mc_po_method_sf.

    "Payment method from header if empty.
    LOOP AT mt_bapisditm ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_bapisditm>).
      CLEAR <lfs_bapisditm>-vw_uepos.
      IF <lfs_bapisditm>-pymt_meth IS INITIAL.
        <lfs_bapisditm>-pymt_meth = ms_bapisdhd1-pymt_meth.
      ENDIF.
* Processing item extension
      IF ms_bapisdhd1-refdoc_cat_long = ms_refdoc_cat-contract.
        CLEAR ls_bape_vbap.
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_bapiparex ASSIGNING <lfs_bapiparex>.
        CLEAR <lfs_bapiparex>.
        ls_bape_vbap-posnr            = <lfs_bapisditm>-itm_number.
*        ls_bape_vbap-oicontnr         = <lfs_bapisditm>-ref_doc.   NEED TO APPEND CUSTOM FIELDS IN STND STRUCTURE SO NOT ADDING FOR NW
*        ls_bape_vbap-oic_kmpos        = <lfs_bapisditm>-ref_doc_it.
        <lfs_bapiparex>-structure     = lc_bape_vbap.
        <lfs_bapiparex>-valuepart1    = ls_bape_vbap.

        CLEAR ls_bape_vbapx.
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_bapiparex ASSIGNING <lfs_bapiparex>.
        CLEAR <lfs_bapiparex>.
        ls_bape_vbapx-posnr           = <lfs_bapisditm>-itm_number.
*        ls_bape_vbapx-oicontnr        = abap_true.
*        ls_bape_vbapx-oic_kmpos       = abap_true.
        <lfs_bapiparex>-structure     = lc_bape_vbapx.
        <lfs_bapiparex>-valuepart1    = ls_bape_vbapx.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    "Is Schedule Line is not passed from SF - assume full quantity and current date for it
    SORT mt_bapischdl BY itm_number ASCENDING.
    LOOP AT mt_bapisditm ASSIGNING <lfs_bapisditm>.
      READ TABLE mt_bapischdl WITH KEY itm_number = <lfs_bapisditm>-itm_number TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS BINARY SEARCH.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_bapischdl ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_bapischdl>).
        CLEAR <lfs_bapischdl>.
        <lfs_bapischdl>-itm_number = <lfs_bapisditm>-itm_number.
        <lfs_bapischdl>-req_qty = <lfs_bapisditm>-target_qty.
        <lfs_bapischdl>-req_date = sy-datum.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT mt_bapisdtext ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_bapisdtext>).
      IF <lfs_bapisdtext>-langu IS INITIAL.
        <lfs_bapisdtext>-langu = sy-langu.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    "Pricing condition for % value correction
    SELECT kschl,krech
      FROM t685a
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_t685a)
      WHERE kappl = @lc_kappl_v.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SORT lt_t685a BY kschl.
    ENDIF.
    LOOP AT mt_bapicond ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_bapicond>).
      READ TABLE lt_t685a ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_t685a>) WITH KEY kschl = <lfs_bapicond>-cond_type.
      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        CASE <lfs_t685a>-krech.
          WHEN lc_krech_a OR lc_krech_h OR lc_krech_i.
            IF <lfs_bapicond>-currency IS NOT INITIAL.
              <lfs_bapicond>-cond_value = <lfs_bapicond>-cond_value * 10.
            ENDIF.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            "do nothing.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.


  endmethod.

  method PREPARE_BAPIX_PARAMETERS.
    DATA: lr_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lt_componentsx TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lr_ref         TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <lfs_bapi_struct>   TYPE any,
      <lfs_bapix_struct>  TYPE any,
      <lfs_t_bapi_table>  TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
      <lfs_t_bapix_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    IF iv_bapi_struct IS NOT INITIAL.
      ASSIGN (iv_bapi_struct) TO <lfs_bapi_struct>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. ELSE. ENDIF. "TODO - handling.
      ASSIGN (iv_bapix_struct) TO <lfs_bapix_struct>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. ELSE. ENDIF. "TODO - handling.

      lr_structdescr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lfs_bapi_struct> ).
      DATA(lv_bapi_stype) = lr_structdescr->get_relative_name( ).
      lt_components = lr_structdescr->get_components( ).

      LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_comp>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <lfs_comp>-name OF STRUCTURE <lfs_bapi_struct> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_v_field>).
        IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND <lfs_v_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          IF <lfs_v_field> IS NOT INITIAL.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT <lfs_comp>-name OF STRUCTURE <lfs_bapix_struct> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_v_fieldx>).
            IF sy-subrc = 0. ELSE. ENDIF. "TODO - handling.
            IF <lfs_v_fieldx> IS ASSIGNED.
              <lfs_v_fieldx> = abap_true.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    IF it_bapi_table IS NOT INITIAL.
      ASSIGN (it_bapi_table) TO <lfs_t_bapi_table>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. ELSE. ENDIF. "TODO - handling.
      ASSIGN (it_bapix_table) TO <lfs_t_bapix_table>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. ELSE. ENDIF. "TODO - handling.

      LOOP AT <lfs_t_bapi_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_bapi_line>).
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lfs_t_bapix_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_bapix_line>).
        CLEAR <lfs_bapix_line>.
        lr_structdescr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lfs_bapix_line> ).
        lv_bapi_stype = lr_structdescr->get_relative_name( ).
        lt_components = lr_structdescr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING <lfs_comp>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT <lfs_comp>-name OF STRUCTURE <lfs_bapi_line> TO <lfs_v_field>.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND <lfs_v_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            IF <lfs_v_field> IS NOT INITIAL.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT <lfs_comp>-name OF STRUCTURE <lfs_bapix_line> TO <lfs_v_fieldx>.
              IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND <lfs_v_fieldx> IS ASSIGNED.
                IF <lfs_comp>-type->absolute_name = ms_abstract_name-bapiupdate. "'\TYPE=BAPIUPDATE'.
                  <lfs_v_fieldx> = abap_true.
                ELSE.
                  <lfs_v_fieldx> = <lfs_v_field>.
                ENDIF.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

  endmethod.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_extnumber) = sy-datum && sy-uzeit && cs_deep_entity-salesorder.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_ballog

            mo_ballog->add_sy_message(

            ).

           " for given salesforce document - sales order already exists in sap
*          MESSAGE e004(zsd00) WITH ms_deep_entity-salesforcereference lv_vbeln INTO mv_dummy.  "For given SF reference (&1) Sales Order already exists in SAP (&2).
          mo_ballog->add_sy_message( ).

objects.description: Singleton business logic class behind the sales order creation OData service for the Salesforce (SF) integration. It takes a deep entity (ZSD_S_SO_HEADER_EXP with items, partners, schedule lines, conditions, texts), maps OData fields to BAPI structures using the ZSD_T_API_MAP001 mapping table, fills BAPISDHD1/BAPISDITM/BAPISCHDL/BAPICOND and their X-structures, splits long texts, checks whether a Salesforce reference already exists, reads TVARVC order-type ranges, updates user status via I_CHANGE_STATUS and commits with BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT.

* Call RFC commit work functionality
DATA lt_message      TYPE bapiret2. "#EC NEEDED
DATA lv_message_text TYPE BAPI_MSG.
DATA lo_logger       TYPE REF TO /iwbep/cl_cos_logger.
DATA lv_subrc        TYPE syst-subrc.

lo_logger = /iwbep/if_mgw_conv_srv_runtime~get_logger( ).

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
      EXPORTING
      wait   = abap_true
    IMPORTING
      return = lt_message.
  ELSE.
    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
      DESTINATION iv_rfc_dest
    EXPORTING
      wait                  = abap_true
    IMPORTING
      return                = lt_message
    EXCEPTIONS
      communication_failure = 1000 MESSAGE lv_message_text

CLASS ZCL_ZSD_SALESORDER_CRE_DPC_EXT IMPLEMENTATION.


  method /IWBEP/IF_MGW_APPL_SRV_RUNTIME~CREATE_DEEP_ENTITY.
**TRY.
*CALL METHOD SUPER->/IWBEP/IF_MGW_APPL_SRV_RUNTIME~CREATE_DEEP_ENTITY
*  EXPORTING
**    iv_entity_name          =
**    iv_entity_set_name      =
**    iv_source_name          =
*    IO_DATA_PROVIDER        =
**    it_key_tab              =
**    it_navigation_path      =
*    IO_EXPAND               =
**    io_tech_request_context =
**  IMPORTING
**    er_deep_entity          =
*    .
**  CATCH /iwbep/cx_mgw_busi_exception.
**  CATCH /iwbep/cx_mgw_tech_exception.
**ENDTRY.

    DATA: ls_deep_entity_h TYPE zsd_s_so_header_exp,
          ls_deep_entity_r TYPE zsd_s_so_request_exp2.

    data(lo_instance) = ZCL_ZSD_SALESORDER=>GET_INSTANCE( ).

    CASE iv_entity_name.
      WHEN ms_entity_types-so_header. "'SO_Header'.
        io_data_provider->read_entry_data( IMPORTING es_data = ls_deep_entity_h ).
        lo_instance->process_single_so( CHANGING cs_deep_entity = ls_deep_entity_h ).
      WHEN ms_entity_types-so_request. "'SO_Request'.
        io_data_provider->read_entry_data( IMPORTING es_data = ls_deep_entity_r ).
*        lo_instance->process_multi_so( CHANGING cs_deep_entity = ls_deep_entity_r ).
    ENDCASE.




  endmethod.
ENDCLASS.
objects.description: Data provider extension for the sales order creation OData service. It redefines CREATE_DEEP_ENTITY so that a POST on SO_Header reads the incoming deep payload (header with items, partners, schedule lines, texts) into ZSD_S_SO_HEADER_EXP and hands it to ZCL_ZSD_SALESORDER=>PROCESS_SINGLE_SO, which builds and calls the sales order BAPI. A SO_Request branch for multiple orders is prepared but commented out. Use it to create sales orders from an external system through OData.

objects.name: zcx_zca_exception
objects.source:
class ZCX_ZCA_EXCEPTION definition
  public
  inheriting from CX_STATIC_CHECK
  create public .

public section.

  interfaces IF_T100_DYN_MSG .
  interfaces IF_T100_MESSAGE .

  methods CONSTRUCTOR
    importing
      !TEXTID like IF_T100_MESSAGE=>T100KEY optional
      !PREVIOUS like PREVIOUS optional .
  methods APPEND_MESSAGE_SY .
  methods APPEND_MESSAGE
    importing
      !IV_MSGID type SYMSGID optional
      !IV_MSGTY type SYMSGTY default CL_ESH_ADM_CONSTANTS=>GC_MSGTY_E
      !IV_MSGNO type SYMSGNO
      !IV_MSGV1 type ANY optional
      !IV_MSGV2 type ANY optional
      !IV_MSGV3 type ANY optional
      !IV_MSGV4 type ANY .
  methods PREPARE_STACK_MESSAGE
    importing
      !IT_CALLSTACK type ABAP_CALLSTACK
    returning
      value(RV_TEXT) type STRING .
  methods CLEAR .
  methods DISPLAY .
  methods DISPLAY_MESSAGE
    importing
      !IV_FIRST type ABAP_BOOL optional
      !IV_DISPLAY_LIKE type SYMSGTY optional .
protected section.
private section.

  constants GC_STACK_LEVEL type I value '2' ##NO_TEXT.
  data MS_MSG type BAPIRET2 .
  data MT_MSG type BAPIRET2_T .
  constants GC_DEFAULT_LOG type BALOBJ_D value 'LOG_ENTRY' ##NO_TEXT.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS ZCX_ZCA_EXCEPTION IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD append_message.
    DATA:
      lv_dummy     TYPE string,
      lv_source    TYPE string,
      lt_callstack TYPE abap_callstack.
    IF iv_msgid IS INITIAL.
      CALL FUNCTION 'SYSTEM_CALLSTACK'
        EXPORTING
          max_level = gc_stack_level
        IMPORTING
          callstack = lt_callstack.
      lv_source = prepare_stack_message( lt_callstack ).
      MESSAGE e205(ts) WITH lv_source INTO lv_dummy.
      ms_msg-id          = sy-msgid.
      ms_msg-type        = sy-msgty.
      ms_msg-number      = sy-msgno.
      ms_msg-message_v1  = sy-msgv1.
      ms_msg-message_v2  = sy-msgv2.
      ms_msg-message_v3  = sy-msgv3.
      ms_msg-message_v4  = sy-msgv4.
    ELSE.
      ms_msg-id          = iv_msgid.
      ms_msg-type        = iv_msgty.
      ms_msg-number      = iv_msgno.
      ms_msg-message_v1  = iv_msgv1.
      ms_msg-message_v2  = iv_msgv2.
      ms_msg-message_v3  = iv_msgv3.
      ms_msg-message_v4  = iv_msgv4.
    ENDIF.
    MESSAGE ID ms_msg-id TYPE ms_msg-type NUMBER ms_msg-number
      WITH ms_msg-message_v1 ms_msg-message_v2 ms_msg-message_v3 ms_msg-message_v4
      INTO ms_msg-message.
    APPEND ms_msg TO mt_msg.
  ENDMETHOD.


  method APPEND_MESSAGE_SY.

     me->append_message( iv_msgid = sy-msgid
                        iv_msgty = sy-msgty
                        iv_msgno = sy-msgno
                        iv_msgv1 = sy-msgv1
                        iv_msgv2 = sy-msgv2
                        iv_msgv3 = sy-msgv3
                        iv_msgv4 = sy-msgv4 ).
  endmethod.


  method CLEAR.
    clear :ms_msg.
    refresh : mt_msg.
  endmethod.


  method CONSTRUCTOR.
CALL METHOD SUPER->CONSTRUCTOR
EXPORTING
PREVIOUS = PREVIOUS
.
clear me->textid.
if textid is initial.
  IF_T100_MESSAGE~T100KEY = IF_T100_MESSAGE=>DEFAULT_TEXTID.
else.
  IF_T100_MESSAGE~T100KEY = TEXTID.
endif.
  endmethod.


  method DISPLAY.
  endmethod.


  METHOD display_message.
    DATA:
          ls_msg TYPE bapiret2.
    IF iv_first = abap_true.
      READ TABLE mt_msg INDEX 1 INTO ls_msg.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ELSE.
        "Error handling here
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      ls_msg = ms_msg.
    ENDIF.
    IF ls_msg IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF iv_display_like IS INITIAL.
        MESSAGE ID ls_msg-id TYPE ls_msg-type NUMBER ls_msg-number
          WITH ls_msg-message_v1 ls_msg-message_v2 ls_msg-message_v3 ls_msg-message_v4
          DISPLAY LIKE iv_display_like.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.


  method PREPARE_STACK_MESSAGE.
    READ TABLE it_callstack INDEX gc_stack_level ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_callstack>).
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    rv_text = <lfs_callstack>-mainprogram && space && <lfs_callstack>-include && space && <lfs_callstack>-blocktype.
  endmethod.
ENDCLASS.
objects.description: Cross-application exception class collecting BAPIRET2 messages for later display or logging. Built on CX_STATIC_CHECK with T100 message support, it can append the current SY message, append an explicit message with variables, or generate a default error text from the calling program and include via SYSTEM_CALLSTACK. It keeps a message table, clears it, and displays the first or last message. Used by ZCL_ZCA_APPLOG and suitable for any custom program needing structured error collection.

objects.name: zaif_ii_flightbooking_in
objects.source:
interface ZAIF_II_FLIGHTBOOKING_IN
  public .


  methods POSTBOOKINGS_01
    importing
      !INPUT type SXIDAL_FBO_REQUEST_MT
    raising
      CX_SXIDAL_TECHNICAL_PROBLEMS .
endinterface.
objects.description: Inbound service interface for receiving flight booking requests through SAP XI/PI or the Application Interface Framework. It defines a single method, POSTBOOKINGS_01, that accepts a SXIDAL_FBO_REQUEST_MT message (SAP's standard flight demo booking request type) and raises CX_SXIDAL_TECHNICAL_PROBLEMS on technical errors. A developer would implement this interface in a proxy class to post incoming flight bookings from an external system.

objects.name: zapi_aes128_bene_reg
objects.source:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Report ZAPI_AES128_BENE_REG
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
REPORT zapi_aes128_bene_reg.

START-OF-SELECTION.

  TRY.
* Create instance with test credentials
      DATA(lo_payee_mgmt) = NEW zcl_axis_payee_mgmt(
        iv_client_id     = 'TEST-CLIENT-ID'
        iv_client_secret = 'TEST-CLIENT-SECRET'
      ).

      " Create test beneficiary data
*  DATA(ls_beneficiary) = VALUE zcl_axis_payee_mgmt=>ty_bene_insert(
*    benecode     = 'VEND01264215'
*    benename     = 'Test Beneficiary'
*    beneaccnum   = '1234567890'
*    beneifsccode = 'HDFC0000523'
*    beneactype   = '10'
*    benebankname = 'HDFC BANK'
*    beneemail    = 'test@example.com'
*    benemobile   = '9999999999'
*    benelei      = '1234567890'
*  ).
*" Register beneficiary
*  DATA(lv_success) = lo_payee_mgmt->register_beneficiary( ls_beneficiary ).
      DATA: lt_beneficiaries TYPE zcl_axis_payee_mgmt=>tt_bene_insert.

      APPEND VALUE #(
          apiversion   = '1.0'
          benecode     = 'VEND01264215'
          benename     = 'Test Vendor'
          beneaccnum   = '1234567890'
          beneifsccode = 'HDFC0000523'
          benebankname = 'HDFC Bank'
          beneaddr1    = 'Test Address'
          beneemail    = 'test@example.com'
          benemobile   = '1234567890'
        ) TO lt_beneficiaries.


      " Process registration
      IF lo_payee_mgmt->register_beneficiary( lt_beneficiaries ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        MESSAGE 'Beneficiary registration successful' TYPE 'S'.
      ELSE.
        MESSAGE 'Failed to register beneficiary' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.
*  IF lv_success = abap_true.
*    MESSAGE 'Beneficiary registered successfully' TYPE 'S'.
*  ELSE.
*    MESSAGE 'Failed to register beneficiary' TYPE 'E'.
*  ENDIF.

*  CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
*      MESSAGE lx_error TYPE 'E'.
  ENDTRY.
objects.description: Test driver program for registering a vendor as a payment beneficiary with Axis Bank. It instantiates ZCL_AXIS_PAYEE_MGMT with placeholder client credentials, builds a hard-coded beneficiary record (code, name, account number, IFSC, bank, email, mobile) into a table, calls REGISTER_BENEFICIARY and issues a success or error message with COMMIT WORK. Useful as a reference for how to call the Axis Bank beneficiary registration API from ABAP.

objects.source:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Report ZRFI_VENDOR_AGEING
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
REPORT ZRFI_VENDOR_AGEING.

TYPE-POOLS: slis. " SLIS contains all the ALV data types

INCLUDE zrfi_vendor_ageing_new_top. ""Global declaration==
INCLUDE zrfi_vendor_ageing_new_sel. ""Selection Screen declaration==
INCLUDE zrfi_vendor_ageing_new_sub. ""Subroutine declaration==
objects.description: Main program for a vendor open item ageing report in Finance, structured with TOP, SEL and SUB includes and the SLIS type pool for ALV output. It selects vendor open items by company code, vendor, profit centre, GL account, special GL indicator, document and business area as of a key date, and buckets them into configurable ageing intervals (30/60/90/120/180 days). Use it to analyse overdue payables by vendor.

objects.description: Selection screen include for the vendor ageing ALV report. It declares select-options over BSEG, LFA1 and BSIK for company code (default AESL), vendor, profit centre, GL account, key date, special GL indicator, document number and business area; radio buttons for line item versus summary output; five configurable ageing-day thresholds (30, 60, 90, 120, 180); a basis choice for ageing (invoice date, due date, baseline date, etc.); and a download checkbox.

In the visible source it contains only the header comment and no code, so the processing logic has either not been written yet or lives elsewhere. Check the main program before assuming any ageing calculation exists here.
